fixes.what: The Isle of Wight loss to Sussex is dated 666 (Cliopatria's year, c1) while both neighbours date the gift to 661, and the Meon valley that went with it is in neither the gain nor the loss.
fixes.why: Wulfhere of Mercia page: 'raided the Isle of Wight in 661', then 'He subsequently gave both the island and the territory of the Meonware ... to his godson King Æthelwealh' (no year); lead: 'He conquered the Isle of Wight and the Meon valley and gave them to King Æthelwealh'. wihtgar /ledger/1: vassal_start kingdom-of-sussex 661 (c3, 'conquered the island in 661 and gave overlordship to his godson'); kingdom-of-sussex /ledger/2: gain from kingdom-of-mercia 661 (the Meonwara).
fixes.fix: Move the loss to 661 (c2, cite https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kingdom_of_Sussex or the Isle of Wight page the wihtgar dossier cites) and mark keyframe kingdom-of-mercia_661 adjust without the island, or keep 666 and say why in the note; add the Meon valley (a place region on the Meon) to the 661 gain and to the loss.

fixes.fix: Split the 705 gain into three (counterparts kingdom-of-gwynedd, kingdom-of-powys, kingdom-of-gwent), each the intersection of minus(Mercia 705, Mercia 692) with that neighbour's previous shape; all stay c1.

fixes.fix: Subtract Wessex 787 in the 800 correction (Wessex was a client to 802) and add a 806 gain from kingdom-of-wessex (c1, minus(Wessex 783, Wessex 806)), or explain the 800 date.
